art_direction: 两片不同宽度的弧叶在浅杏底上对向悬浮，墨绿与钴蓝相衬。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Arrange two broad leaf-like shapes facing each other across a slim curved gap. Make one leaf taller and narrower, the other low and full, so their negative space resembles a gently twisting ribbon. Use dark forest green for one and cobalt blue for the other on a pale apricot field. Keep the forms entirely flat, with no botanical veins or realistic stems. The visual interest comes from unequal curves and carefully balanced spacing, not from extra decorative marks. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
